data.action: 坐于木桌前手握鹅毛笔抄写手稿，抬头微笑
data.animaCaption: Seated at a cluttered library desk piled with old tomes, she pauses with a quill pen over an open manuscript and looks up through round glasses with a warm smile.
data.camera: 中景，平视，书堆与墨水瓶前景
data.description: 阳光洒落的修会古籍资料室内，书架高耸，菲比戴着圆框眼镜穿着米白针织披肩长裙，伏案用鹅毛笔认真抄录羊皮卷手稿。
data.lighting: 高窗斜射的柔和日光与台灯暖光
data.promptProse: Surrounded by towering bookshelves in the Order's scriptorium, Phoebe wears round reading glasses and an oatmeal knit cardigan, pausing with a feather quill over an illuminated manuscript.
data.title: 菲比 · 修会古籍修复室鹅毛笔抄录手稿
